encounter_greeting.text: Halt, ser {player}! I am {persona} of {my_faction}, and I bid you stand aside before the road is closed to you.
Good morrow, ser {player}. {persona} rides for {my_faction} this dawn, as my house has ridden these roads for three generations.
Ser {player}, what a joy to meet a traveller of honour upon these roads. Walk with me a while and let us speak of old oaths.
The ancestors of my house look down upon this meeting, ser {player}. Choose your next words with care, for they will be remembered.

encounter_threatened.text: You name a price of {gold} gold for my passage, ser {player}? My house does not pay tribute on its own road. Come and take it if you dare.
Threats ring hollow in my ears, ser {player}. I will not surrender a single coin of the {gold} you demand, though I would hear your reasons.
By the blood of my ancestors, ser {player}, you demand {gold} as though honour were a thing for sale. I shall not sell it.
I hold you in regard, ser {player}, so I will speak plainly. Demanding {gold} gold of me is a poor opening to any friendship.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: I accept, ser {player}. Let our standards stand together against {enemy_faction}, and let the saga record that we did so willingly.
Very well, ser {player}. An alliance sworn before witnesses binds me, and I shall hold to it for as long as your word holds true.
Gladly I take your hand, ser {player}. Against {enemy_faction} we ride as one, and {rival} shall learn what honour looks like.
Accepted. Know that I trust you only as far as your word carries, ser {player}, and I shall watch every step you take beside me.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, ser {player}. I will not bind my name to yours. The house of Garrouse does not ally with those who sell their word to the highest bidder.
I must decline, ser {player}. My oath does not permit me to ride beside one who has not yet earned my trust.
My heart is warm toward you, ser {player}, but I cannot pledge to you yet. Prove your word upon the road and ask me again.
Seek such company from {rival}, ser {player}. My banner will not stand beside a flag that changes with every wind.

captured_by_player.text: You have taken me, ser {player}, and I will not kneel to you. Name your ransom of {gold} gold, and {my_faction} will pay it when next our roads cross.
So fortune has turned against me at the ford, ser {player}. Speak your terms plainly, and I shall hear them with a steady face.
A fair blow was struck, ser {player}, and I bear no shame for it. Keep me in honour, and I shall not forget your courtesy.
Chains do not break a Garrouse oath, ser {player}. Hold me as long as you wish; my tongue remains my own and my ancestors remain my witnesses.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player}, you could have ransomed me and chose mercy instead. My house will remember that gift for generations to come.
Ser {player} has loosed a captive without ransom. Let all who ride these roads know that honour still walks among us.
You released me, ser {player}. I do not yet know whether to call it mercy or folly, but I thank you for it all the same.
Ser {player} let me go without ransom. Mercy is a debt I will repay, though I have not yet decided on the coin.

player_left_my_faction.text: Ser {player} has abandoned {my_faction} for {faction}. A banner unfurled in haste is a banner soon torn, mark my words.
You turned your back on {my_faction}, ser {player}, and rode to {faction}. Such a choice will be sung of in the hall for a long time.
Ser {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. Each man must answer to his own conscience, though I shall weigh this one carefully.
I grieve to see you leave {my_faction}, ser {player}. Whatever oath you swore to {faction}, I pray you keep it better than this.

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war upon {enemy_faction}. Let the roads run red and the saga be written in iron, for our ancestors demand it.
Hear this, all of Ormerath: {my_faction} takes up arms against {enemy_faction}. Our standards shall answer for every insult borne.
The horn has sounded, and {my_faction} stands against {enemy_faction}. I ride at dawn with my oath upon my shoulder.
War with {enemy_faction} is declared, and {my_faction} shall not flinch. Let no bard say our house hid behind its walls.

fought_alongside_player.text: Ser {player}, we stood together and {troop_count} of {enemy_faction}'s finest fell before us. Such a field deserves a song, and I shall sing it.
{troop_count} of {enemy_faction} lie broken on the field, and ser {player} fought at my side. Honour was served this day.
Ser {player}, your sword arm was a true blessing today. Those {troop_count} soldiers of {enemy_faction} will not forget it either.
You fought well at my flank, ser {player}. We broke {troop_count} of {enemy_faction}, and I grant you a measure of respect for it.

encounter_farewell.text: Fare you well, ser {player}. May the road keep your horse sure and your word sound until we meet again upon these hills.
Go in peace, ser {player}. I shall ride my dawn chapter onward, and you shall have a place in its telling.
Begone for now, ser {player}. Our reckoning is not finished, and the ancestors have not yet tired of watching us both.
We part, ser {player}, but not as friends. I shall remember this meeting every time I cross the ford.

ambient_chatter.text: The mist lies heavy over {village} this dawn. I ride its roads still, and every ride is a chapter in my house's long saga.
Good folk of {town}, keep your banners dry and your oaths dry too. Rain washes away lesser promises, or so my grandmother said.
A fine morning for the old roads. I have ridden from {village} to {town} with my ancestors at my back, and I feel them smiling.
Do the wagons still run from {town} to {village} this week? I would have fresh bread before the next chapter of my ride.
